info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Virtual Account Update API
info.description: The Virtual Account Update API allows for the modification of existing virtual account details within the deposit lending service. This endpoint is critical for managing account attributes, ensuring that customer information remains current and accurate. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and lending platforms that require real-time updates to account status or configurations. Users can leverage this capability to enhance customer service and streamline financial operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific virtual account associated with the deposit lending service. You can modify various attributes of the virtual account as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to modify the details of a specific virtual account identified by ACC-200045 in the deposit lending system. Ensure that you include all required fields as specified in the schema, as any missing or incorrect information may result in a failed update.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the virtual account has been updated.
